verdict.rationale: Azure runs a public status page at azure.status.microsoft that reports active events, offers outage notifications, and points users to Azure Service Health. Nothing in the evidence documents per-service incident history or post-incident reports. One community report during an outage says the page stayed green and linked to a portal that was itself down, which lowers confidence in its accuracy. Missing for 10: per-service historical incident record, published post-incident reports/RCAs, independent corroboration that the status page reflects real outages.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports

citations.quote: Get notified of outages that impact you
There are currently no active events. Use Azure Service Health to view other issues that may be impacting your services.
